rule.description: Flags an owning body (class body, or module-level state-bearing object literal) that concentrates at least 8 method-like members, references at least 4 distinct imported modules, and holds at least 2 of its own state fields.

checks.description: Detect one owner body that concentrates the whole project-file-tree workspace lifecycle - directory scanning, entry metadata, sort ordering, tree pruning and the create/rename/remove lifecycle - behind a singleton/factory service.
checks.detected_relation: owner body (class body or module-level state-bearing object) -> 4+ imported module domains, 8+ method-like members, 2+ own state fields
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: WorkspaceService spans the filesystem, interop invocation, path-join and sort-option domains, threads mutable sort state between absorbed methods, and exposes factory/entry-point plumbing that cements the coupling into every file-tree call site, so the one body has many unrelated reasons to change.

matches.evidence: Class WorkspaceService holds 13 method-like members (shared, forProject, getEntryMeta, scanDir, processEntries, compare, sortFn, sortTree, removePath, addFile, renameEntry, deleteEntry, plus the constructor), references 4 imported module domains (@tauri-apps/api/fs, @tauri-apps/api/tauri, @tauri-apps/api/path, @/utils/types) and keeps 2 instance state fields (activeSort, projectDir). The same members absorbed the responsibilities previously owned by getFileMeta (E2), removePath (E3), fetchDir scanning (E4), addFileHandler (E5), Root sorting (E6), File rename/delete (E7) and Tree directory delete (E8).

excluded: React function components (Root.tsx, File.tsx, Tree.tsx, App.tsx, Editor and Settings components) are functions with hooks, not class or owner-object bodies; they are call sites, not flagged owners.

The zustand store literal in src/store/appStore.ts has 7 function-valued members for one state-container responsibility and is passed as an argument to create(), not a module-level owner object; it stays below every threshold.
Editor/markdown rule configuration objects (TipTap options, marked/turndown extensions) are argument-position literals with few handlers and a single responsibility each.
Interface and type declarations, enumerations, and plain functions without a class/object owner body.
Dependency code under node_modules is never analyzed; the checker only parses the repository's src/ tree.
A module-level object literal that is not state-bearing state-sharing owner form (fewer than 8 method-like members, fewer than 4 imported module domains, or fewer than 2 state fields) is not flagged.
